ios.desc:
Collect autographs on your iPhone and iPad from celebrities and friends. 

Turn your camera on, record your screen in the app and collect autographs with recorded face.
Find celebrities and ask for an autograph! 

Your girlfriend could draw you a personal drawing.
Your son could draw for you an image of yourself, image you would want to hold in memory of the phone.

Cognomen app works with Apple Pencil. 
To collect truly authentic autographs use Apple Pencil but for original and natural version of the autograph use a finger.

Share autograph on your social media channels. 
You could share your drawings on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and other.

App recognize your location and date of the autograph.
